report_name: FAA Outage Not a Cyberattack; FBI Investigates Software Update

identities.name: Federal Aviation Administration
identities.description: U.S. government agency that experienced a nationwide ground stop for over four hours on November 13, 2026, due to a system failure. The outage was not a cyberattack but is being investigated for causes including a software update or legacy equipment failure.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
identities.description: U.S. government agency involved in the investigation of the FAA outage, reportedly probing a software update as a potential cause.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: U.S. government agency (part of DHS) that participated in the multi-agency investigation into the FAA system failure.

identities.name: National Security Agency
identities.description: U.S. government agency that participated in the multi-agency investigation into the FAA system failure.
